title: Base Read Holding Registers variant 4
purpose: Use a boundary-adjacent Read Holding Registers request for 125 registers, producing a large but structurally ordinary request.

messages.label: Boundary Read Holding Registers request, unit 13, address 0x0100, quantity 125
Read Holding Registers response (register data bytes)

expected_behavior: The server should parse the request as a large Read Holding Registers operation and return the requested register data when supported, or a normal Modbus exception response.
constraints_preserved: Request MBAP length is 0006 because the unit identifier and five-byte PDU are included.
Function code 03, starting address, and quantity fields remain ordered and width-consistent.
The target quantity 007d represents 125 registers, a conservative boundary-adjacent read quantity.
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability report is available. The larger request is intended for length and size coverage while preserving plausible protocol relationships, not to encode a known vulnerability.
